module.name: scpyocto
module.description: PyOcto phase associator for SeisComP. Receives picks from the PICK messaging group and associates them into origins using the PyOcto space-partitioning algorithm.

parameter.name: pyocto.lat_min
parameter.description: Minimum latitude of the search area (degrees)

parameter.name: pyocto.lat_max
parameter.description: Maximum latitude of the search area (degrees)

parameter.name: pyocto.lon_min
parameter.description: Minimum longitude of the search area (degrees)

parameter.name: pyocto.lon_max
parameter.description: Maximum longitude of the search area (degrees)

parameter.name: pyocto.depth_min
parameter.description: Minimum depth of the search area (km)

parameter.name: pyocto.depth_max
parameter.description: Maximum depth of the search area (km)

parameter.name: pyocto.vp
parameter.description: P wave velocity for the 0D homogeneous model (km/s)

parameter.name: pyocto.vs
parameter.description: S wave velocity for the 0D homogeneous model (km/s)

parameter.name: pyocto.time_before
parameter.description: Overlap between consecutive time slices (s). Should exceed the travel time across the network.

parameter.name: pyocto.n_picks
parameter.description: Minimum total number of picks required to declare an event

parameter.name: pyocto.n_p_picks
parameter.description: Minimum number of P picks required per event

parameter.name: pyocto.n_s_picks
parameter.description: Minimum number of S picks required per event

parameter.name: pyocto.n_p_and_s_picks
parameter.description: Minimum number of stations contributing both a P and S pick

parameter.name: pyocto.pick_match_tolerance
parameter.description: Maximum residual (s) for assigning a pick to an event in the refinement step

parameter.name: pyocto.min_interevent_time
parameter.description: Minimum time (s) between two declared events

parameter.name: pyocto.max_pick_age
parameter.description: Discard picks older than this many seconds from the sliding buffer
